outputs.explanation: Panel A is a representative segmented reconstruction of a single actin filament at the pre-conoidal rings; no quantification or statistics are shown, so replicate reporting is not required.

Panel B is a representative 3D segmentation of a sporozoite basal end with no quantified/statistical data. The caption additionally notes the IMC invagination was 'observed in three cells,' providing reproducibility context even though not formally required.
This is a representative tomographic slice with manually highlighted filaments; no quantification requiring replicate reporting.
Panel D is a schematic/representative rendering of a lateral cell section showing actin populations; no quantitative or statistical data are presented.

replicate_statements: A slice through the average volume of TPFs showing their position relative to the IMC membranes.
outputs.explanation: This panel shows an 'average volume,' i.e., a subtomogram average combining multiple particles/observations, but neither the number of particles/subvolumes averaged nor the type of replicate (e.g., independent tomograms, particles, cells) is stated in the caption or on the panel.

replicate_statements: consistent with myosin dimensions (observed in two different locations)
outputs.explanation: Panel F explicitly reports that the connecting densities were observed in two different locations (N = 2 shown on the image), and the panel presents representative data without summary statistics, so an n of 2 is acceptable.
